quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: My friend, the panda will never fulfill his destiny, nor you yours, until you let go of the illusion of control.
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: If you only do what you can do, you will never be more than you are now.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: Finally, a worthy opponent! Our battle will be legendary!
quotes.author: Tai Lung

quotes.text: I like who I am!
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: See, that's the thing, Shen. Scars heal.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: Maybe Oogway was right about you. You aren't completely useless after all.
quotes.author: Tai Lung

quotes.text: My time has come. You must now continue your journey without me. You must believe...
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: I too came from humble beginnings.
quotes.author: The Chameleon

quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Sometimes we do the wrong things for the good reasons.
quotes.author: Mr. Ping

quotes.text: Every master must find his path to inner peace.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: You can chain my body, but you will never chain my warrior spirit!
quotes.author: Crane

quotes.text: Before the battle of the fist, comes the battle of the mind.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: I'm not a big fat panda. I'm THE big fat panda.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: There is always something more to learn.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: Now, who wants to do the right thing for the wrong reasons?
quotes.author: Zhen

quotes.text: Skadoosh.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: Your story may not have such a happy beginning, but that doesn't make you who you are. It is the rest of your story, who you choose to be.
quotes.author: Soothsayer

quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: It was never my destiny to stop you. I have set another on that path.
quotes.author: Master Oogway
